newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mogas touch firmer on tightness.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mogas touch firmer on tightness.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady, bar firmer tight gasoline, traders said on Monday.
Prompt gasoline remains very tight with a eurograde loading today securing $203.50 fob, about $6 above first half August levels.
Gas oil outright prices eased 50 cents with August Ipe closing at $167.00 a tonne. An EN590 cargo moved at the steady spread of Sep IPE +$4.50. Barges were quiet.
European fuel oil markets were quiet with low sulphur easing a little, high sulphur barges holding around $90 a tonne and straight-run still strongly sought after.
